decisions.target:
开启通往恶魔空间的炼狱之门，踏入并传送到附近位置。当你踏出炼狱之门时，炼狱之火随之喷发，造成 %0.2f 恶魔之火伤害，影响 %d 码内所有生物，并留下余烬，在 4 回合内额外造成 %0.2f 恶魔之火伤害。
		穿越空间增强了你的直觉，让你能够在 4 回合内觉察到 %d 码内的所有敌对生物。
		伤害受法术强度加成，范围随技能等级增大。
decisions.reason: Sense duration4 is passed to EFF_SENSE; existing Chinese4 preserved.

decisions.target:
吸取燃烧中的烈焰，将自己包裹其中。除去半径 10 内的敌方生物身上的燃烧效果，同时制造一层持续 %d 回合、强度为 %d 的护盾，每移除一层燃烧效果，护盾强度增加 15%%。
		当护盾效果结束时，将在半径 %d 范围内释放一次火焰爆炸，灼烧范围内的所有敌方生物 3 回合，造成等于护盾初始值的伤害。
decisions.reason: Fiery Aegis action ball radius10; existing Chinese10 preserved.

decisions.target:
向目标冲锋，如果到达目标位置，则攻击目标造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		若攻击命中，将释放半径 3 码的强烈火焰冲击，将目标以外的所有敌对生物击退 %d 码，并对范围内的敌人（包括目标）造成 %d 点火焰伤害。
		至少要从 2 码外开始冲锋。
decisions.reason: Detonating Charge blast radius3; second placeholder goes to knockback dist fireRadius; existing Chinese maps both correctly.

64: 	name = "Fiery Aegis", short_name="DEVOURING_FLAMES", image = "talents/fiery_aegis.png",--Change on major release
65: 	type = {"corruption/heart-of-fire", 2},
66: 	require = corrs_req2,
67: 	points = 5,
68: 	cooldown = 10,
69: 	getBaseShield = function (self, t) return self:combatTalentSpellDamage(t, 75, 250) end,
70: 	getRange = function(self, t) return math.ceil(self:combatTalentScale(t, 2, 4.5)) end,
71: 	getDur = function(self, t) return math.ceil(self:combatTalentScale(t, 3, 5)) end,
72: 	action = function(self, t)
73: 		local tg = {type="ball", nolock=true, range=0, radius = 10, friendlyfire=false}
74: 		local burncount = 0
75: 		self:project(tg, self.x, self.y, function(px, py)
76: 			local target = game.level.map(px, py, engine.Map.ACTOR)
77: 			if not target then return end
78: 			local burns = {}
79: 			for eff_id, p in pairs(target.tmp) do
80: 				local e = target.tempeffect_def[eff_id]
81: 				if e.subtype.fire and p.power and e.status == "detrimental" then
82: 					burns[#burns+1] = {id=eff_id, params=p}
83: 					burncount = burncount + 1
84: 				end
85: 			end
86: 			for i, d in ipairs(burns) do
87: 				target:removeEffect(d.id)
88: 			end
89: 		end)
90: 		local shieldboost = (1 + burncount * 0.15) * t.getBaseShield(self, t)
91: 		self:setEffect(self.EFF_FIRE_SHIELD, t.getDur(self, t), {power=shieldboost, radius = t.getRange(self, t), src=self})
92: 		return true
93: 	end,

96: 		When the shield ends, it releases a burst of fire in a radius of %d around you, burning all enemies for 3 turns, doing damage equal to the initial power of the shield.]]):
97: 		tformat(self:getShieldDuration(t.getDur(self, t)), self:getShieldAmount(t.getBaseShield(self, t)), t.getRange(self, t))
